description: Real bug: unpacking the uploaded workspace deletes a tracked file at the archive's path. Fixed later in 6b4a72d.
head: fb22b909fdb21a3231084652ead26d7c013fbe33

pullRequest.title: perf(sandbox): upload the checkout instead of downloading a tarball
pullRequest.body:
The sandbox used to download GitHub's tarball of the pull request head and
unpack it before it reported ready: for appwrite/appwrite about 420 MB,
10 to 18 s to download and 7 to 10 s to unpack, on every review.

Hansi already has the checkout. openSandbox now writes it with git
archive, without binary files (images, videos, archives) and files over
10 MB, uploads it to the sandbox agent's /files and unpacks it there, as
hansi.codes does with sbx. For appwrite/appwrite that is 26 MB written in
about 2.4 s, while the sandbox starts. The run_command description says
what is left out.

getArchiveUrl has no caller left and goes.

findings.issue: The unpack runs `tar -xzf .hansi-workspace.tar.gz && rm -f .hansi-workspace.tar.gz` in the workspace. A repository that tracks a file at that same root path gets it extracted by tar and then deleted by the rm, so the sandbox's checkout is missing a tracked file.
